claims.text: Leads naturally split into a ready-to-buy group, a persuadable group whose outcome depends on follow-up, and a group that will never convert
The persuadable middle group is where follow-up speed and persistence most affect close outcomes
The platform offers a 14-day free trial, no card required, cancel anytime

Black Arrow offers a 14-day full platform trial with no card required.
